chunks: He is only a man possessed; so wait and watch him for a time.
ai.seo_question: What did the disbelievers say about the Prophet Muhammad when he first began receiving revelation?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the disbelievers' attempt to delegitimize the Prophet's message by attributing it to 'jinnah' (madness or divine possession), a common rhetorical strategy to dismiss divine inspiration. It serves as a divine directive for the believers to exercise sabr (patience) and await the inevitable vindication of the Prophet, reinforcing the concept of divine timing in the face of skepticism.
